name: magnetic-button
title: Magnetic button
description: A CTA eases toward the cursor within a small radius and springs back on leave.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { DzButton } from '@dzup-ui/core'
import { vMagnetic, useReducedMotion } from '../motion'

const reduced = useReducedMotion()
</script>

<template>
  <!-- Offset clamped to a few px so the click target never breaks. -->
  <DzButton
    v-magnetic="{ strength: 0.45, radius: 16, disabled: reduced }"
    variant="solid"
    tone="primary"
    size="lg"
  >
    Pull me closer
  </DzButton>
</template>

export { vMagnetic } from './directives/magnetic.ts'
export { useReducedMotion } from './useReducedMotion.ts'
